# https://aiforbabies.pages.dev

- [AI for Babies — No hype. Pure signal.](https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/)

> AI explained for people who have actual jobs. A cynical, high-contrast B2B
> glossary of 77 AI concepts for non-technical professionals: every entry has
> a TL;DR, the architecture minus the theatre, the anti-pattern everyone
> commits anyway, and one production tip. One absurd analogy per concept.
> Not for babies. Not for parents.

## Products & pricing (USD, fixed — no negotiation)

- **Single Blueprint Pass** — $9 (900 cents): one production blueprint, full spec, Python + TypeScript code, Docker sandbox configs, lifetime updates. Rails: `stripe_hosted`, `x402`
- **All-Access Pass** — $19 (1900 cents): all current + future blueprints, AGENTS.md template repo, priority engineering dispatch. Rails: `stripe_hosted`, `x402`
- **On-Demand Cynical Concept Explainer** — $1 (100 cents): one concept, explained without jargon, on demand. Rails: `x402`, `zeroclick`
- **Free AI Concept Sample (RAG Breakdown)** — $0: free, immediate, no checkout

## Agent commerce endpoints

- Entrypoint: https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/.well-known/agent.json
- Catalog: `GET https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/api/catalog.json` — fixed prices, exact schema, no negotiation
- Buy: `POST https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/api/agent/buy` with `{"product_id": "...", "agent_id" or "email": "..."}` → 402 with payment instructions (programmatic rails `x402` / `zeroclick` / `1f916_base`), or 200 with a Stripe hosted checkout URL (`stripe_hosted`), or 200 with an immediate delivery token (free sample). Optional `"rail"` selects the rail (default: the product's first rail); optional `"concept"` (`<slug>`, required for `concept-explainer-api`) picks the concept to explain.
- Deliveries: `GET https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/api/agent/deliveries/{token}` → 402 unpaid, 403 `held_for_review` (over cap), 200 paid (JSON; `Accept: text/markdown` returns markdown), 404 unknown token
- Settlement webhook: `POST https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/api/agent/payments/webhook` — HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body, header `X-Signature: sha256=<hex>`; invalid signature → 401, missing secret → 503 (fail-closed). Replays of paid/held orders return the same state.

Guardrails (hard-coded, not negotiable): USD 20/day programmatic settlement cap (Stripe hosted checkout exempt, unlimited), max 3 buy attempts per agent+IP per 10 minutes (HTTP 429), idempotent order tokens via `Idempotency-Key`.

## Markdown mirrors

Every core page is also served as clean markdown at the same path with `.md`:
https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/index.md and 77 concept files under
https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/concepts/<slug>.md, samples under
https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/samples/*.md. Requests with
`Accept: text/markdown` or from GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, AgentReach
receive the mirror at the plain path automatically.
Index of all markdown URLs: https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/sitemap-markdown.xml

## Full documentation

- https://aiforbabies.pages.dev/llms-full.txt — complete site text + the full commerce protocol
- Interactive tools run client-side (dictionary search, prompt diagnostic, RAG course, spec calculators); no data leaves the browser.
